llm_response.reason: The website displays extremely high discounts on all products (up to 90%), which is highly unrealistic. The claimed operator is a Chinese company, but the website targets Japanese users and is hosted on a .top domain, which is commonly abused for scams. The contact email does not match the domain and is generic, there is no telephone support, and contact is through the Line app only, which is inappropriate for real businesses. The privacy policy and company info are generic/copy-pasted, and there is no evidence of an online reputation or customer reviews. The domain was registered very recently (December 2024) and all owner and contact information is redacted, which is typical of scammers who wish to remain anonymous. All these elements match multiple scam characteristics such as unusually low prices, ambiguous contact details, use of urgency tactics, generic privacy policy, non-existent business transparency, and recent anonymous registration.
